projectStatus.overallStatus: M8 promoted with explicit boundary · M9 design next
projectStatus.focus: Freeze the M8 research record, preserve SFM-1/exact-memory/SFM-T/workspace contracts, and carry the measured cognition/utilization bottleneck into a fresh M9 design pass without preselecting a mechanism.

logs.title: M8.12 promotion review closed
logs.summary: M8 completed as the Semantic Memory milestone. SFM-1, exact memory, SFM-T and typed workspace memory contracts were promoted. FounderV0CompatibilityBridge v1 remains a frozen research baseline rather than the final cognitive interface.

logs.title: M8.11 memory-utilization experiment accepted
logs.summary: 249/249 repository tests and 46/46 experiment-validity gates passed. Correct single-memory context improved target log-probability on 467/512 cases (91.21%), while exact generation remained 0/64 and neighborhood memory was negative on average.

logs.title: M8.10 established causal Founder integration
logs.summary: 237/237 regression and 35/35 gates passed. Verified memory changed Founder V0 next-token distributions on 16/16 known probes without changing Founder, canonical memory, or generation 80.

logs.title: M8.9 SFM-T multi-memory recall frozen
logs.summary: SFM-T added deterministic retrieval breadth while preserving retrieve-one semantics and the memory/thinking boundary. The accepted r2 preserved a failed r1 gate as evidence and froze the discrete retrieval interface.

logs.title: M8.8 offline consolidation accepted
logs.summary: Accepted evidence was consolidated from generation 64 to 80 without new acquisition, reinforcement, or gradients. A second pass produced no drift and discrete retrieval remained unchanged.

logs.title: M8.5–M8.7 established knowledge, generalization and exactness
logs.summary: SFM-1 acquired 16 stable facts; frozen retrieval returned 16/16 known facts, rejected 516/516 negatives, preserved 4/4 ambiguities, and exact memory resolved 16/16 values with corruption and injection fail-closed tests.

logs.title: M7 evaluation passed; Stark Founder V0 frozen
logs.summary: M7 verified the validation-selected step-18,000 checkpoint, held-out loss 3.8932, and the weak reasoning/knowledge/context baselines that became the control for M8.

logs.title: PRETRAIN-001 completed
logs.summary: Founder V0 completed 19,456 optimizer steps and 250,009,600 processed tokens. Validation selected step 18,000 at 226,177,792 tokens as canonical.

logs.title: M6 training engine acceptance closed
logs.summary: CUDA/BF16 training, controlled overfit, exact crash/resume, leakage controls and real-data generalization established the reproducible substrate used by PRETRAIN-001.

logs.title: M1–M5 Founder architecture assembled
logs.summary: 256d embeddings, RoPE, local causal attention, gated Transformer blocks and the eight-layer 11.54M-parameter Founder language model were assembled and acceptance-tested.

logs.title: Stark Tokenizer V0 frozen
logs.summary: The 12,288-token BPE tokenizer was contract-tested and frozen to a content-addressed model-facing identity.

milestones.title: Next Cognitive Milestone
milestones.summary: Not yet architecturally frozen. M8 evidence identifies selective memory interpretation/utilization as the next bottleneck; M9 will be designed from a fresh research question and acceptance contract.

notes.title: Memory is not thinking
notes.body: SFM may store, associate, activate, rank, retrieve and preserve. It does not decide which memory is true, applicable, current or actionable.

notes.title: READ is not LEARN
notes.body: M8.10 and M8.11 used memory with zero acquisition, reinforcement, consolidation, retraction or gradient steps. Founder output is not evidence and does not automatically become memory.

notes.title: Neural association is not exact truth
notes.body: SFM selects a fact identity approximately; exact payload and provenance are resolved from an independently integrity-bound exact-memory substrate.

notes.title: Causal delivery is not reliable utilization
notes.body: Memory changed Founder computation on all 16 M8.10 known probes and helped single-memory targets on 91.21% of M8.11 cases, yet exact answer generation remained 0/64. The next bottleneck is cognition, not durable storage.

notes.title: Preserve failed evidence
notes.body: M8.9 r1 failed a bad floating-score invariant after consolidation. The attempt was preserved and r2 corrected the gate to the discrete retrieval interface rather than rewriting history.
